reviewStatus: All 210 icons named in 45 groups. Ten families (50 sprites) updated through user review. No outstanding naming decisions; accepted multi-identity labels remain intentionally searchable.

conventions.grouping: Collapse colour-only variants; keep bloody, cracked, broken and shape differences distinct. Feather variants run in steps of five, unlike most consecutive groups.
conventions.naming: Original stem plus visual object/features and colour. No species or gameplay effects inferred.
conventions.uncertainty: User-reviewed finger, spine and lizard-leg labels complete the review. Accepted egg/scale/nodule and scale/carapace alternatives remain searchable; exact identities are not asserted beyond the agreed labels.
